{{Quote|The Supreme Warmaster of the Advozse Hegemony has offered his life in reparation for his people's misdeeds. The Advozsec will never again pose a threat.|[[Darth Malgus]]|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Hammer Station}}</ref>}}
